collection.description: Strange misfortunes trouble the village, and the chief must decide whose advice to follow.
approximations: the spiritual leaders' and the scientists' losses are made at once and told by the game's own line ("The village loses food." / "The village loses tech points."): the engine's (award) is a gain only, so the owner's "Your village loses (award) food / tech points." is not shown with the amount
the five travellers and four advisors are ten villagers the event casts (min_eligible 10: the chief and nine others); the advisor not asked is cast but never named

intro.text: (Leader), the tribal chief, has been noticing something troubling. For the past 9 months, (leader.he/she) has heard reports of fish floating dead on the water. Crop harvests have been failing, and birds have been falling out of the sky. Even the villagers have started to feel weak and tired, almost to the point of being unable to work. The scientists and healers have been trying to investigate but have not found a definite explanation for these occurrences.

ask.text: With so little information to go on, and the problems mounting further, (leader) must make a decision quickly for the sake of the village. But, who should (leader) go to for advice?

choices.label: Call the Naturalists to a Discussion
Talk with the Scientists and Healers

adv1.text: The spiritual leaders believe that the village should pray and offer gifts. Surely these unfortunate occurrences must stem from transgressions the villagers have made towards the things that guide their fate. "Make haste. The spirits are patient and kind, but such transgressions are not easily forgiven," (advisor1) says. "One must be pure of heart, mind and body to right what is wrong. It will take time. Time which grows ever shorter." Chief (leader) thanks the spiritual leaders for their wise counsel and makes (leader.his/her) decree.

hear1.text: "Hear me, O {@tribe}! Your Chief speaks!" (leader) calls from on high. A crowd gathers in the amphitheater to listen to (leader.his/her) words.

decree1.text:
"I have consulted with the spiritual leaders, and have heard your cries for help. There is much we know, and much we don't know about the strange misfortunes befalling our village. But I believe we have a plan to fix them!
Look amongst yourselves, all who are eligible to work, and from you pick five to represent our tribe. You alone will travel to find the cause of our suffering, and heal it, for the sake of us all. Now go forth, and discuss your plans with my advisors. They will guide you on your sacred mission. May Isola help us all."
On the day of departure, (leader) meets personally with the chosen representatives and wishes them well on their journey. As they leave, the tribe prays for a whole week, offering gifts of food to the spirits in hopes of granting them salvation.

adv2.text: The magicians think that the factions are in imbalance, and believe that the magical forces that strengthen Isola have been weakened. "The magic that flows within all things is waning," (advisor2) says. "Either our connection, or its source. We must figure out which is true, and remedy it." Chief (leader) thanks the magicians for their wise counsel, and makes (leader.his/her) decree.

On the day of departure, (leader) meets personally with the chosen representatives and wishes them well on their journey. As they leave, the tribe spends a whole week focusing their mental and physical energies towards honing their innate potential. Gradually, they gain strength as well as dexterity and clarity. This newfound strength pushes the villagers to accomplish extraordinary things that temporarily improve their living conditions. Your villagers gain (award) tech points.

adv3.text: The naturalists believe that the factions are in imbalance, and that the natural forces that keep Isola healthy have been disrupted. "The natural cycle of rebirth and renewal is fading," (advisor3) says. "Soon enough, all of Isola will perish if nothing is done. We must figure out what is destroying it and stop it." Chief (leader) thanks the naturalists for their wise counsel, and makes (leader.his/her) decree.

adv4.text: The scientists and healers believe that some organic phenomenon is causing the animals and plants to wither and die. "Perhaps they are being poisoned," (advisor4) says. "Or, something in their environment is adversely affecting their health. Whatever it is, we must do some in-depth experimentation to get to the bottom of this disaster." Chief (leader) thanks the scientists and healers for their wise counsel, and makes (leader.his/her) decree.
